name: naive_osc
summary: Naive (non-band-limited) wave reader: the classic shapes — 0 = saw, 1 = sine, 2 = triangle, 3 = square — as a single Q15 table (fm1_naive_wave), selected by a `shape` param. Aliases (no polyBLEP); pulse width is *not* a shape: apply a `phase_dist` bend before this read (PWM on square/pulse, a phase-distortion timbre on the other shapes).
